body.en:
Wood screws work by cutting or displacing their own path, so the material they enter, not the screw's strength, sets the design rule. In softwood a coarse thread with a sharp point will draw the parts together and hold; in hardwood the same screw will split the board unless a pilot hole is drilled, and in engineered timber the screw must be selected for the panel's density rather than for the timber it replaces. Choosing a screw by length and head shape alone is the reason most timber joints fail early.

The head decides function. A countersunk head sits flush and suits surfaces that will be finished or walked on; a round or pan head leaves a bearing face for brackets and thin parts; a bugle head spreads load under a drywall or sheathing panel and reduces the risk of punching through. The recess matters as much: a Phillips drive cam-outs at a designed torque, which protects the head, while a Torx or square drive transmits more torque without cam-out and suits dense timber and long screws where driving effort is high.

Length and gauge follow from the thickness being joined rather than from a rule of thumb. A common convention is that the threaded length in the receiving member should be about two-thirds of the thickness of the top board, with the screw long enough to pass through the top board without its thread engaging there. If the thread engages in both boards the joint cannot be drawn tight, which is the most frequent cause of a squeaking floor or a rattling panel.

Coating is a decision about moisture, not appearance. Bright zinc plating suits indoor work in dry conditions; hot-dip galvanised or zinc flake is needed wherever timber stays damp, and stainless is the answer for coastal, marine and preservative-treated timber, where the treatment chemicals are aggressive to zinc. Where two different metals meet, the less noble one corrodes first, so a galvanised bracket with stainless screws should be assessed rather than assumed safe.

Driving practice completes the selection. A wood screw driven without a pilot hole into hardwood creates a splitting stress along the grain, and the crack appears weeks later rather than at installation. A pilot hole of the root diameter, drilled to the length of the threaded section, prevents that; a wax or soap lubricant on the thread halves the driving torque in dense timber; and a driver with a clutch set below the head's cam-out torque protects both the head and the board. None of these costs money, and together they remove most of the failure modes that a specification alone cannot.

One commercial note that matters for export buyers: timber screws are sold by count in some markets and by weight in others, and a carton marked by weight is of little use on a site where the fixing schedule is written in pieces. Stating the count, the gauge and the length convention on the carton, and agreeing the packing quantity at order, avoids the shortfalls that appear only when a crew reaches the last row of a deck.

body.es:
Los tornillos para madera están diseñados para unir madera con madera:

Tipos:
- Cabeza plana: Avellanado para una superficie a ras
- Cabeza redonda: Proporciona superficie de apoyo
- Cabeza de corneta: Para paneles de yeso y revestimientos

Características clave:
- Punta afilada para un inicio fácil
- Rosca gruesa para agarre en madera
- Vástago liso para una fácil inserción
- Varias longitudes y calibres

Consejos de selección:
- Longitud: 2.5 veces el espesor de la tabla superior
- Calibre: Ajustar a los requisitos de carga
- Cabeza: Ajustar a la aplicación
- Recubrimiento: El uso en exteriores requiere resistencia a la corrosión. Recursos relacionados: pernos de alta resistencia pernos de anclaje fijaciones de acero inoxidable pernos hexagonales tuercas de seguridad arandelas tornillos autoperforantes tornillos de cabeza hueca. Este marco de adquisiciones se aplica al abastecimiento de fijaciones para construcción, minería, energía, automoción y aplicaciones industriales generales. La lógica de decisión prioriza la consistencia de la calidad, la fiabilidad del proveedor y el costo total de propiedad sobre el precio unitario a corto plazo. Para los compradores B2B en África, América Latina y el Sudeste Asiático, las consideraciones adicionales incluyen requisitos aduaneros regionales, opciones de consolidación de contenedores y mecanismos de seguridad de pago. Las especificaciones estandarizadas que se aplican a través de los proyectos reducen el tiempo de capacitación, el tiempo de procesamiento de solicitudes de cotización (RFQ) y el esfuerzo de incorporación de proveedores.

صُممت براغي الخشب لتثبيت الخشب بالخشب:

الأنواع:
- رأس مسطح: للغرس في السطح ليكون بمستوى واحد
- رأس مستدير: يوفر سطح تحميل
- رأس بوقي: لألواح الجبس والتغطية

الميزات الرئيسية:
- طرف حاد لبدء سهل
- أسنان خشنة لتماسك أفضل مع الخشب
- ساق ملساء لسهولة الإدخال
- أطوال ومقاييس متنوعة

نصائح الاختيار:
- الطول: 2.5 ضعف سمك اللوح العلوي
- القياس: طابقه مع متطلبات الحمل
- الرأس: طابقه مع التطبيق
- الطلاء: الاستخدام الخارجي يتطلب مقاومة للتآكل الموارد ذات الصلة: براغي عالية الشد براغي تثبيت (أنكر) مثبتات الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ براغي سداسية صواميل قفل حلقات (وردات) براغي ثقب ذاتي براغي رأس مقبس. ينطبق إطار المشتريات هذا على توريد المثبتات لقطاعات البناء والتعدين والطاقة والسيارات والتطبيقات الصناعية العامة. تعطي منطق اتخاذ القرار الأولوية لاتساق الجودة وموثوقية المورد والتكلفة الإجمالية للملكية بدلاً من سعر الوحدة قصير الأجل. بالنسبة للمشترين في قطاع الأعمال (B2B) في أفريقيا وأمريكا اللاتينية وجنوب شرق آسيا، تشمل الاعتبارات الإضافية متطلبات الجمارك الإقليمية وخيارات تجميع الحاويات وآليات أمن الدفع. تساعد المواصفات الموحدة التي يمكن تطبيقها عبر المشاريع في تقليل وقت التدريب، ووقت معالجة طلبات الأسعار (RFQ)، وجهد ضم الموردين الجدد.
body.fr:
Les vis à bois sont conçues pour fixer le bois sur le bois :

Types :
- Tête fraisée : S'encastre pour une surface affleurante
- Tête ronde : Offre une surface d'appui
- Tête trompette : Pour les cloisons sèches et le bardage

Caractéristiques principales :
- Pointe acérée pour un amorçage facile
- Filetage grossier pour une meilleure accroche dans le bois
- Tige lisse pour une insertion facile
- Diverses longueurs et calibres

Conseils de sélection :
- Longueur : 2,5 fois l'épaisseur de la planche supérieure
- Calibre : À adapter aux exigences de charge
- Tête : À adapter à l'application
- Revêtement : L'utilisation en extérieur nécessite une résistance à la corrosion. Ressources connexes : boulons à haute résistance goujons d'ancrage fixations en acier inoxydable boulons hexagonaux écrous frein rondelles vis autoperceuses vis à six pans creux. Ce cadre d'approvisionnement s'applique à l'achat de fixations pour la construction, l'exploitation minière, l'énergie, l'automobile et les applications industrielles générales. La logique de décision privilégie la cohérence de la qualité, la fiabilité des fournisseurs et le coût total de possession plutôt que le prix unitaire à court terme. Pour les acheteurs B2B en Afrique, en Amérique latine et en Asie du Sud-Est, les considérations supplémentaires incluent les exigences douanières régionales, les options de groupage de conteneurs et les mécanismes de sécurisation des paiements. Les spécifications normalisées applicables à travers divers projets réduisent le temps de formation, le temps de traitement des appels d'offres et les efforts d'intégration des fournisseurs.
body.pt:
Os parafusos para madeira são projetados para fixar madeira em madeira:

Tipos:
- Cabeça chata: Escareados para superfície nivelada
- Cabeça redonda: Fornece superfície de apoio
- Cabeça corneta: Para drywall e revestimentos

Principais características:
- Ponta afiada para início fácil
- Rosca grossa para fixação na madeira
- Haste lisa para inserção fácil
- Vários comprimentos e bitolas

Dicas de seleção:
- Comprimento: 2,5x a espessura da tábua superior
- Bitola: Combine com os requisitos de carga
- Cabeça: Combine com a aplicação
- Revestimento: Uso externo requer resistência à corrosão Recursos relacionados: parafusos de alta resistência parafusos de ancoragem fixadores de aço inoxidável parafusos sextavados porcas autotravantes arruelas parafusos autoperfurantes parafusos com soquete. Esta estrutura de aquisição aplica-se ao fornecimento de fixadores para construção, mineração, energia, automotivo e aplicações industriais gerais. A lógica de decisão prioriza a consistência da qualidade, a confiabilidade do fornecedor e o custo total de propriedade em vez do preço unitário de curto prazo. Para compradores B2B na África, América Latina e Sudeste Asiático, considerações adicionais incluem requisitos aduaneiros regionais, opções de consolidação de contêineres e mecanismos de segurança de pagamento. Especificações padronizadas que funcionam em vários projetos reduzem o tempo de treinamento, o tempo de processamento de RFQ e o esforço de integração de fornecedores.

Шурупы по дереву предназначены для крепления деревянных элементов:

Типы:
- Потайная головка: для установки заподлицо с поверхностью
- Круглая головка: обеспечивает опорную поверхность
- Рожковая головка: для гипсокартона и обшивки

Основные характеристики:
- Острый наконечник для легкого засверливания
- Крупная резьба для надежного удержания в дереве
- Гладкий стержень для легкого вхождения
- Различные длины и диаметры

Советы по выбору:
- Длина: 2,5x толщины верхней детали
- Диаметр: подбирается под требования нагрузки
- Головка: подбирается под тип применения
- Покрытие: для наружных работ требуется антикоррозийная защита. Похожие ресурсы: высокопрочные болты анкерные болты крепеж из нержавеющей стали болты с шестигранной головкой стопорные гайки шайбы самосверлящие винты винты с внутренним шестигранником. Эта закупочная модель применяется для поиска крепежа в строительстве, горнодобывающей промышленности, энергетике, автомобилестроении и общепромышленных целях. Логика принятия решений отдает приоритет стабильности качества, надежности поставщика и совокупной стоимости владения, а не краткосрочной цене за единицу продукции. Для B2B-покупателей в Африке, Латинской Америке и Юго-Восточной Азии дополнительными факторами являются региональные таможенные требования, возможности консолидации контейнеров и механизмы безопасности платежей. Стандартизированные спецификации, применяемые в различных проектах, сокращают время на обучение, обработку запросов (RFQ) и адаптацию поставщиков.
body.ja:
木ネジは、木材同士を締結するために設計されています：

種類：
- 皿頭：沈み込み、表面を平らにする
- 丸頭：座面を確保する
- ラッパ頭：乾式壁や外装下地用

主な特徴：
- 簡単に食い込む鋭い先端
- 木材にしっかり食いつく粗目ねじ
- 挿入がスムーズな滑らかなシャンク
- 豊富な長さと径のバリエーション

選定のヒント：
- 長さ：締結する板厚の2.5倍
- 径：荷重要件に合わせる
- 頭部：用途に合わせる
- 表面処理：屋外使用時は耐食性が必要 関連リソース: 高張力ボルト アンカーボルト ステンレス鋼ファスナー 六角ボルト ロックナット ワッシャー ドリルねじ ソケットスクリュー。本調達フレームワークは、建設、鉱業、エネルギー、自動車、および一般産業用途のファスナー調達に適用されます。意思決定ロジックでは、短期的な単価よりも、品質の一貫性、サプライヤーの信頼性、および総所有コスト（TCO）を優先します。アフリカ、ラテンアメリカ、東南アジアのB2Bバイヤー向けには、地域の税関要件、コンテナ混載オプション、および支払いセキュリティメカニズムを考慮する必要があります。プロジェクト間で共通化された仕様書は、トレーニング時間、RFQ（見積依頼）処理時間、およびサプライヤーのオンボーディングの手間を削減します。
body.de:
Holzschrauben sind für die Befestigung von Holz auf Holz konzipiert:

Typen:
- Senkkopf: Versenkt für bündige Oberflächen
- Rundkopf: Bietet eine Auflagefläche
- Trompetenkopf: Für Trockenbau und Schalungen

Hauptmerkmale:
- Scharfe Spitze für einfaches Ansetzen
- Grobgewinde für festen Halt im Holz
- Glatter Schaft für einfaches Eindrehen
- Verschiedene Längen und Stärken

Auswahlhilfe:
- Länge: 2,5-fache Dicke des oberen Brettes
- Stärke: Passend zu den Lastanforderungen
- Kopf: Passend zur Anwendung
- Beschichtung: Außenbereich erfordert Korrosionsbeständigkeit. Verwandte Ressourcen: hochfeste Schrauben Ankerschrauben Edelstahl-Verbindungselemente Sechskantschrauben Sicherungsmuttern Unterlegscheiben Bohrschrauben Innensechskantschrauben. Dieser Beschaffungsrahmen gilt für die Beschaffung von Verbindungselementen für das Bauwesen, den Bergbau, die Energiebranche, die Automobilindustrie sowie allgemeine industrielle Anwendungen. Die Entscheidungslogik priorisiert Qualitätskonsistenz, Lieferantenzuverlässigkeit und Gesamtbetriebskosten gegenüber kurzfristigen Stückpreisen. Für B2B-Einkäufer in Afrika, Lateinamerika und Südostasien umfassen zusätzliche Überlegungen regionale Zollanforderungen, Optionen für die Containerkonsolidierung und Mechanismen zur Zahlungssicherheit. Standardisierte Spezifikationen, die projektübergreifend gelten, reduzieren den Schulungsaufwand, die Zeit für die RFQ-Bearbeitung und den Aufwand für das Lieferanten-Onboarding.

लकड़ी के पेंच (Wood screws) लकड़ी को लकड़ी से जोड़ने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं:

प्रकार:
- फ्लैट हेड: सतह के बराबर (flush) करने के लिए काउंटरसिंक
- राउंड हेड: बेयरिंग सतह प्रदान करता है
- बगल हेड: ड्राईवॉल और शीथिंग के लिए

प्रमुख विशेषताएँ:
- आसानी से शुरू करने के लिए नुकीला सिरा
- लकड़ी को पकड़ने के लिए मोटा चूड़ी (coarse thread)
- आसानी से डालने के लिए चिकना शैंक (shank)
- विभिन्न लंबाई और गेज में उपलब्ध

चयन युक्तियाँ:
- लंबाई: ऊपर के बोर्ड की मोटाई का 2.5 गुना

heading.zh: 板式螺丝（Lag Screw / 方头木螺丝）

body.en:
Coach screws, also called lag screws, do the work that a wood screw cannot: they carry structural load into heavy timber, and they are installed with a spanner rather than a driver. Their geometry reflects that. A hexagonal head accepts a real torque, the shank is thick enough to carry shear across a joint, and the coarse thread is designed to bite into timber rather than to cut a fine path through it. The consequence is that a coach screw needs a pilot hole sized to its shank, and a washer under the head to spread the clamp load.

Installation decides whether a coach screw performs. The pilot hole should be the shank diameter in the member being pulled and smaller in the member receiving the thread, so that the thread bites without splitting. Driving with an impact tool rather than a steady torque risks over-tightening, which crushes the timber under the washer and removes the preload that the joint depended on. In softwood the crushing is visible; in hardwood it happens first at the surface and shows up later as a loose connection.

Where a coach screw replaces a bolt in a structural connection, the substitution should be checked rather than assumed. A bolt develops capacity through bearing on the member and shear across its section, with a nut providing the clamp; a coach screw develops capacity through thread engagement in one member only. That single-sided engagement is why coach screws are common in decking, fencing, sleepers and light frame work, and rare in connections that a structural engineer has designed around a bolted joint.

Durability follows the same logic as wood screws but with higher stakes, because coach screws are used outdoors. Hot-dip galvanised is the baseline for exposed timber, stainless for coastal and preservative-treated applications, and the washer should be of the same material as the screw, since a mismatched washer is the first place a joint rusts.

Where a coach screw is used in a treated timber that is still wet, the joint will loosen as the timber dries and shrinks around the thread. Installing them after the timber has reached its service moisture, or accepting a re-tightening step as part of the programme, avoids the complaint that follows a first summer. Detailing that keeps water off the screw head is worth as much as an extra coating class, because a dry joint survives where a wet one will not.

For buyers comparing offers, the useful question is not which coach screw is cheapest but which quotation states the shank diameter, the thread length, the head diameter and the coating class. Two screws of the same nominal size can differ in the length of the threaded portion, and that difference decides how much of the joint is actually held.

A final site habit: keep one box of the specified coach screws and washers sealed until the inspection walk, so that a missing item can be replaced from the same batch rather than from a mixed bin that has already lost its labelling.

body.en:
Timber connectors transfer load between members without relying on the screw's own capacity, and they exist because timber is weak in tension perpendicular to the grain and strong in bearing parallel to it. A connector spreads load over an area, converts a tension demand into bearing and shear, and lets a joint be designed rather than estimated. The main families are joist hangers and post bases, which carry vertical load into a member; straps and ties, which resist uplift and lateral movement; and plate and bracket systems for heavier frame connections.

Connector performance depends on the fasteners that attach it, which is where most site failures originate. A hanger specified with a given number and type of nails or screws performs as tested only when those fasteners are used in that number and pattern; substituting longer screws, fewer nails, or a different diameter changes the capacity without any visible sign. The right practice is to keep the connector's published fastener schedule with the drawings and to require it at inspection.

Corrosion is the second issue and it is often hidden. Connectors are usually galvanised, and in preservative-treated or damp timber the zinc is consumed faster than the published rating suggests. The safe approach is to match the connector's coating class to the timber treatment and the exposure, and to inspect the connector, not only the timber, at service intervals. A joint that looks sound from the outside can have a connector that has lost most of its section at the embedded face.

Where connectors and timber meet, detailing matters as much as the hardware. Water trapped between a connector and timber is the standard cause of premature failure, so a capillary break, a drained detail or a raised base is worth more than a heavier coating. Designers who treat the connector as a piece of hardware and the detail as part of the structure get joints that last; those who select the connector and leave the detail to the site get joints that pass inspection and fail in service.

A practical inspection routine for timber connections is short: check that the specified connector is present rather than a general-purpose bracket, that the fastener count and pattern match the schedule, that the coating is intact at the embedded face, and that no water is standing against the connector. Each of those four checks catches a class of failure that is invisible once the structure is closed up, and together they take less time than a single repair.

Connector selection should also account for the direction of load, not only its size. A hanger carrying a joist downward is a bearing problem, while the same hanger resisting uplift after a roof has been lifted by wind is a different problem in the same hardware; specifying by catalogue number alone can meet the first and miss the second. Writing the load direction on the drawing, with the connector's published capacity for that direction, is the check that prevents a roof strap from being chosen for a joist.

Tipos:

- Bases de postes: Aseguran los postes al concreto
- Conectores de retención: Resisten fuerzas de elevación

Materiales:
- Acero galvanizado: Interior estándar
- Galvanizado por inmersión en caliente: Exterior/ubicaciones húmedas
- Acero inoxidable: Marino/costero

Beneficios:
- Mayor capacidad de carga
- Menor necesidad de muescas en la madera
- Detalles de conexión estandarizados

Los precios reales del mercado fluctúan con los costos de las materias primas (acero, zinc, níquel), los costos de energía, los costos laborales y los tipos de cambio de divisas. q.en: What is the difference between coach screws and wood screws?

a.en: Coach screws (lag screws) have a hex head for wrench tightening and are heavy-duty for wood-to-wood connections. Wood screws have slotted or Phillips heads and are lighter duty, designed for assembling wood components.

q.en: What size coach screw do I need for deck joists?

a.en: For deck joist connections, M8 × 80mm or M10 × 100mm coach screws are typically used. The screw should penetrate at least 2.5x the thickness of the second board. Check local building codes for specific requirements.

q.en: Can coach screws be used in pressure-treated timber?

a.en: Yes, hot-dip galvanized (HDG) coach screws are recommended for ACQ (alkaline copper quaternary) pressure-treated timber. Standard zinc-plated screws may corrode. Always check the coating compatibility with your treatment type.

q.en: Do I need to pre-drill pilot holes for coach screws?

a.en: Yes, especially for hardwoods. Pre-drill a pilot hole equal to the screw's root (core) diameter. This prevents splitting and ensures proper thread engagement. For softwoods, you may skip pre-drilling for smaller sizes.

q.en: How far should coach screws penetrate into the second timber?

a.en: For proper holding power, coach screws should penetrate at least 2.5x the screw diameter into the receiving timber. For an M10 screw, that means at least 25mm penetration into the second board.
